title: Account termination and final financial settlement workflow
workflow: Receive closure request and verify contract owner
Validate liens, holds, overdrafts, pending payments and tax obligations
Reconcile authoritative balance and financial transactions
Authorize final payout/transfer independently where required
Confirm settlement and closure prerequisites before changing state
Retain immutable customer statements, contract and decision history
invariants: No closure on unreconciled payment or unknown external outcome
Financial closure entries require approved balanced journal
Bank cannot treat account closure as cancellation of obligations
No silent deletion of customer records subject to retention
Customer termination rights and notices follow applicable legal policy
Maker-checker applies to high-impact close-out and payouts
planned_tests: Closed account rejects new authorized debit
approval_gate: Institution termination rules, settlement/accounting authority and executed financial reconciliation tests.
